headline: Committee works on FY27 budget, adds funds for hospice, power supply and wildfire recovery

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Up to $3 million for upcountry wildfire rebuild, recovery, and mitigation
meeting.summary: The committee approved $150,000 for a medical-device power supply program, $750,000 for rural hospice care and up to $3 million for upcountry wildfire recovery, 8-1. Budget review was set to resume the next day at nine o'clock.
meeting.recap: The committee worked on the proposed fiscal year 27 County of Maui budget.[[0:02:15]] A testifier asked for tactile guide strips at crosswalks to help people with vision impairments.[[0:07:21]] A member proposed $150,000 for a power supply program for people who rely on medical devices.[[1:12:11]] That program passed with nine ayes.[[1:21:47]] The committee added $750,000 for hospice care in rural areas, with nine ayes.[[1:53:42]] Up to $3 million for upcountry wildfire rebuild, recovery and mitigation passed eight to one.[[3:26:04]] A motion would use $1.8 million in water carryover savings to map West Maui groundwater with airborne data.[[4:23:21]] That condition passed with eight ayes and one member recused.[[5:46:17]] The meeting was set to continue the next day at nine o'clock.[[7:36:36]]
decided: The condition passed on a roll call vote.
The condition passed on a roll call vote.
The final motion was read into the record; the vote result is not in the captions.
meeting.next: The committee chair said she will find a nonprofit to run the upcountry rebuild funds and bring paperwork before first reading.

boards.name: Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

issues.oneLine: A motion would use $1.8 million in water carryover savings to map West Maui groundwater with airborne data.
issues.why: The member who proposed it said the data would show the county better where to drill wells.
issues.next: The budget director said the water director will move forward with the project.
issues.brief: The member said a second year would map the Haleakalā aquifer.[[#1]] The budget director said the administration would prefer the state take the lead on this work.[[#2]] The water department fixed its budget because restricted cash included customer deposits that cannot pay for capital projects.[[#3]]

issues.oneLine: The committee considered a grant of up to $3 million to Homestead Community Development Corporation to buy homes for permanently affordable rentals.
issues.why: The group said all seven occupied homes in its program house Maui wildfire households.
issues.next: The member who made the motion said staff will ask the group for more details.
issues.brief: The group said its goal is to add two to three units with $2 million.[[#1]] A member proposed $150,000 more for Maui Mediation Services, citing more need for eviction mediation.[[#2]] A member said the Lānaʻi project with DHHL would clear the island's housing list.[[#3]]

issues.oneLine: The committee approved up to $3 million for upcountry wildfire rebuild, recovery and mitigation, eight to one.
issues.why: The committee chair said upcountry residents and rentals were affected by the wildfire.
issues.next: The chair said she will find a nonprofit to run the funds and bring paperwork before first reading.
issues.brief: The budget director warned that funds set aside for recent storm recovery may not be reimbursable.[[#1]] Up to $2 million for South Maui environmental and health impacts passed seven to one, with one excused.[[#2]] $250,000 to keep the Lahaina Resource and Recovery Center running passed with eight ayes.[[#3]]
